No lever is fitted to a price residual and no input is pinned to actuals.

exceptions.magnitude: model 0.83 vs actual 2.08 TWh (-60.2%; unchanged vs the neiso-55 keeper)
exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (downstream of the price_tail / winter-scarcity item)
exceptions.reason: PS arbitrage throughput tracks the intraday price spread. The residual under-cycle is winter-concentrated: the LP's cold-month spread stays compressed at the dual-fuel oil-parity cap, and the real Northfield fleet additionally cycles near-daily for reserves/regulation the energy-only LP does not remunerate. Per the neiso-ps-undercycling diagnosis the PS number may only move DOWNSTREAM of price structure, never via a storage knob. temp_dependent_derate slightly DEEPENS the gap (-56.3% -> -60.2%): the capacity-neutral summer reshape trims a little of the shoulder-season spread the PS fleet was arbitraging, without adding winter spread. Closes only with the winter fuel-inventory build and/or in-LP reserve co-optimization value reaching storage; never via a storage knob. neiso-56 tested the ledger's named closure path — in-LP reserve co-optimization value reaching storage (storage reserve-eligible in the co-opt) — and it is DORMANT: reserves clear free from idle thermal headroom, no reserve value reaches the pumped-storage fleet, and discharge is byte-similar to the keeper (0.827 vs 0.828 TWh in 2025).
